title: StaICC: Standardized Evaluation for Classification Task in In-context Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the entropy of the model's output label probability distribution when provided with a meaningless or empty pseudo query, measuring the model's inherent baseline tendency toward specific label tokens.

Calculating the entropy of the model's output label probability distribution when prompted with a pseudo query constructed by randomly sampling tokens according to the frequency distribution of the calibration dataset.

Calculating the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the model's averaged output probability distributions on real test inputs and the actual ground-truth label frequency counted from the test set.
